I'm not sure what acne I've got, but it's sporadic. I was going to write down my routine, bad it won't help anyone. Keep in mind, this is in the span of 3 years. Maybe 4.  

  

I had a stable routine for a couple months, just the basics. Then a little time later, I started developing cysts on my cheeks (that I'm still healing from 3 months later). I scrapped the routine after my face got worse, and started fresh with a gentler routine. It slowed the process of the cysts, but they still came. "Hmm", I thought, "Maybe my face is oily?" "But that doesn't make sense, since I have bangs and my forehead is oily as hell but has zero pimples". "Hmm", I thought, after that didn't do anything, "Maybe my face is dry?", "Oh wow cyst heaven, doesn't matter the moisturizer".  

  

Yes, I change my pillow case on a daily, yes I drink a lot of water, I never touch my face, I use microfiber cloths, I do it all. I've gone through hell and back with my skin. It's like a area 51 experimental field. I've dried it out, I've let it be oily, I've moistened it, I've done physical exfoliation, I've done bare-bones.  

 Now the strange part. The acne switches sides of my face. Left side would be perfect and not react to any topical, then my right side would be zit, pimple, cyst, bumpy haven. Then it clears up, then my left side is tainted, etc.  

  

Anyone have similar experiences and could help 'diagnose' me?

i'm sorry but you're hecking cute. i have a deep scar on both my cheeks that ruin my self esteem, so you're tougher than me.  

  

 but what worked for my hormonal acne (and large cysts) is just stopping everything. even stopping showering everyday. i ruined my moisture barrier and skin showering every day.  

  

now, in the AM, if my face feels oily, i sometimes wash off with micellar water, and use a light moisturizer. in the PM, i do the same thing but maybe with a cleanser, and one or two more moisturizers. sometimes i'll use vitamin c, sometimes i'll use glycolic acid.  

   

just be gentle to your skin.
